command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-alert-v4.xml'; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-alert-v4.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-alert-v4.xml > "$XML"; }; tap_node(){ attr=$1; value=$2; dump; coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$attr" "$value"); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $coords; sleep 1; }; master_state(){ xmllint --xpath 'string((//node[@checkable="true" and @enabled="true"])[1]/@checked)' "$XML" 2>/dev/null; }; active_test_count(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -cE 'NotificationRecord\(.*pkg=io\.blueeye .*tag=TEST' || true; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; sleep 2; tap_node content-desc Menu; tap_node text Settings; tap_node text 'Alerts & Collection'; dump; initial=$(master_state); echo detection_initial=$initial; test "$initial" = false; master=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $master; sleep 1; dump; enabled=$(master_state); echo detection_enabled=$enabled; test "$enabled" = true; test_coords=''; for i in 1 2 3 4; do dump; if test_coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" text 'Test alert' 2>/dev/null); then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 1750 500 650 350; sleep 1; done; test -n "$test_coords"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $test_coords; sleep 1; before=$(active_test_count); echo active_test_notification_before_disable=$before; test "$before" -ge 1; uid=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | awk -F= '/userId=/{gsub(/\r/,"",$2); print $2; exit}'); echo package_uid=$uid; echo '--- audio-before-disable ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -E "io.blueeye|uid[ :=]+$uid|USAGE_ALARM|state[:=]started" | head -n 80 || true; master=''; for i in 1 2 3 4; do dump; if master=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable 2>/dev/null); then break; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 650 500 1800 350; sleep 1; done; test -n "$master"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $master; sleep 1; after=$(active_test_count); echo active_test_notification_after_disable=$after; test "$after" -eq 0; dump; final=$(master_state); echo detection_final=$final; test "$final" = false; echo '--- audio-after-disable ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -E "io.blueeye|uid[ :=]+$uid|USAGE_ALARM|state[:=]started" | head -n 80 || true; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_DETECTION_OFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
